findings.evidence: "A threshold is the numeric boundary that triggers an alert once a metric crosses it."
findings.fix: Move the threshold definition to the beginning of the document, before "Open alert settings," or integrate it into the opening of that section so users understand the concept before being asked to select a rule.
findings.violation: The definition of "threshold" appears after the user has already been instructed to select a rule to adjust, breaking the logical flow of a how-to guide. Readers need to understand this concept before following the initial instruction.

findings.evidence: "This is because the console applies the new threshold to every future evaluation of this rule."
